correctness.rationale: Exact neighborhood counts yield necessary and sufficient blade thresholds in the two center cases. The only nonlocal condition, at an omitted center, is implied by the blade thresholds because \(2r-o\ge1\), where \(o\) is the number of odd blade sizes. Enumeration over 269 ordered tuples through graph order 12 confirms the classification, every coefficient, and the minimum formulas.

evidence: A published/internal-search result for complete multipartite graphs gives a global offensive \(k\)-alliance classification on that different graph class.
A windmill with any blade of size at least two has edges inside a blade, while distinct blades have no edges, so it is generally not complete multipartite.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The closest broader family located does not contain heterogeneous windmills except degenerate cases, so it cannot imply the theorem.

value.rationale: The result unifies stars, friendship graphs, and arbitrary unequal-blade windmills, gives a complete all-set classification and factorized cardinality enumerator, and exposes exact parity-sensitive optimizer multiplicities. This is a natural structural theorem rather than a single small numerical instance.
